era: Jura village, France, November 1885 (sections H, S); Paris 1885 (H22-H27); present day 2020s (T01-T05)

characters.hero: bald stickman; outdoors: flat dark-grey cloth cap, faded blue work smock, brown trousers; at home sick: long off-white nightshirt; today: dark-grey baseball cap, blue jacket, jeans
characters.mum: stickman, plain black dress, white linen bonnet covering the head (no hair)
characters.priest: stickman, long black cassock, round black wide-brimmed hat
characters.pasteur: stickman, no beard, black frock coat, small black skullcap
characters.assistant: stickman in a white apron (Pasteur's lab)
characters.meister: small boy stickman, sailor shirt (1885); grown-up caretaker in dark uniform and cap at the Institute gate
characters.meister_mum: stickman woman, white bonnet covering the head
characters.rabies: the villain: wolf-dog head, yellow eyes, a little froth, broken collar with chain, ragged dark frock coat
characters.dog: the neighbour's brown dog (cold open only)
characters.nurse: today: stickman nurse in blue scrubs and a blue scrub cap
characters.extras: villagers, patients, passengers: stickmen in period clothes, no hair

locations.street: Jura lane: stone houses, wooden farm gate, snowy pines
locations.room: hero's bedroom: table with candle and jug on the left, window with snowy pines at the back, bed with brown blanket on the right, wooden chair
locations.lab: Pasteur's lab 1885: benches, flasks, microscope, rabbit cages, window with grey sky only
locations.modern: 2020s street, bathroom, clinic, alley, rural road
